Title: Reject unauthenticated commands
Requirement Text: The ground station shall reject any command message that fails authentication tag verification and shall log the rejection.

Title: Dual-radio failover
Requirement Text: On loss of the primary radio link, the ground station shall fail over to the secondary radio without operator intervention.

Title: Dual-radio failover

Title: Link quality display
Requirement Text: The operator interface shall display current link quality, signal strength, and round-trip latency, updated at least once per second.

Title: Geofence boundary enforcement
Requirement Text: The system shall enforce operator-configured geofence boundaries and alert the operator before a predicted boundary crossing.

Title: Return-to-home on boundary warning timeout
Requirement Text: If the operator does not acknowledge a boundary warning within 15 seconds, the system shall command a return-to-home.

Title: Route upload and validation
Requirement Text: The ground station shall validate an uploaded route for altitude, distance, and boundary violations before allowing it to be sent to the aircraft.

Title: GPS degradation alert
Requirement Text: The ground station shall detect degradation of the GPS solution and alert the operator within 5 seconds.

Title: Navigation solution logging
Requirement Text: The ground station shall log the navigation solution, including position and velocity, at a minimum rate of 5 Hz.

Title: Compass calibration workflow
Requirement Text: The ground station shall provide a guided magnetic compass calibration workflow with pass/fail feedback.

Title: Remaining flight time estimate
Requirement Text: The ground station shall estimate remaining flight time from battery state of charge and current load, updating the estimate at least once per second.

Title: Low battery warnings
Requirement Text: The ground station shall warn the operator when battery charge falls below 30 percent and again below 20 percent.

Title: Arming voltage interlock
Requirement Text: The ground station shall prevent arming when battery voltage is below the configured safe threshold.

Title: Battery telemetry logging
Requirement Text: The ground station shall log battery voltage, current, and temperature at a minimum rate of 1 Hz.

Title: Hot-swap battery detection
Requirement Text: The ground station shall detect a battery hot-swap event and re-initialise power telemetry within 3 seconds.

Title: Load shedding on critical battery
Requirement Text: On reaching the critical battery threshold, the ground station shall command shutdown of non-essential payload loads.
Linked Test Title: Verify: Load shedding on critical battery

Title: Operator action audit log

Title: Night operations display mode

Title: Altitude ceiling enforcement
Requirement Text: The system shall prevent the aircraft from exceeding the operator-configured altitude ceiling.

Title: Motor fault response
Requirement Text: On detection of a motor fault, the system shall initiate a controlled descent at the current position.

Title: Geofence override confirmation
Requirement Text: Overriding a geofence boundary shall require a two-step operator confirmation and shall be recorded in the audit log.

Title: Flight controller heartbeat monitoring

Title: Log synchronisation on reconnection
Requirement Text: When network connectivity is restored, the ground station shall synchronise stored mission logs to the configured server.

Title: Log integrity checksums
Requirement Text: Each stored mission log shall carry a checksum that allows later detection of modification or corruption.

Title: Mission data export
Requirement Text: The ground station shall export mission data in at least one open format suitable for third-party analysis tools.

Title: Log retention period
Requirement Text: The ground station shall retain mission logs for at least 90 days before any automatic deletion.
